policy: Only explicit reviewed phrase-to-widget FontObject contracts are checked. Review producer source, callers, template inheritance and later font changes before refreshing sha256. Buttons bind every declared font state. Font objects resolve through the pinned client font mappings; translated text never selects a font. Dynamic game data, tooltips, menus, chat and unlisted or uncertain consumers have no coverage claim. Empty bindings pin reviewed dependencies or exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read Text, Line, Headers, Refresh, Choose and Attach, and searched UI and Core for SetFont, SetNormalFontObject and any later font change: none. The title is GameFontNormalLarge and the empty-state line GameFontDisableSmall, set only through SetText. The three tab buttons and the Shopping list button inherit SharedButtonSmallTemplate: pinned Blizzard_SharedXML/Shared/Button/ThreeSliceButtonTemplate.xml gives normal GameFontNormal, highlight GameFontHighlight and disabled GameFontDisable, and Refresh disables the selected tab button, so all three states are bound. Row cells (GameFontHighlight), column headers (GameFontNormalSmall), the summary, the footer and the per-tab empty lines take dynamic data or text from other producers and are excluded.
